name: BrowseComp
intro: BrowseComp是一个用于衡量AI代理浏览网页能力的基准。它包含1266个具有挑战性的问题，需要代理在互联网上持续导航以寻找难以发现的信息。尽管问题困难，但答案简短且易于验证，使其成为一个简单易用的评测工具。
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.12516. BrowseComp is built purely by human trainers following SimpleQA-style criteria for fact-seeking questions with single short stable answers. Trainers invert seed facts into questions that are hard to find but easy to verify, confirm GPT-4o with and without browsing, o1, and an early Deep Research model cannot solve them, and perform five simple Google searches to ensure the answer is absent from first result pages. A second trainer attempts a portion; alternative answers trigger feedback and creators whose tasks are solved over 40% of the time revise them. Reviewing 118 tasks with 0% Deep Research pass rate removes 21 format-mismatched, ambiguous, or incorrect tasks from the original 1,287, yielding 1,266. The no-AI human study attempts 1,255 questions and solves 29.2%; browsing-agent short answers are graded for semantic equivalence with the HLE grading prompt.
intro_en: BrowseComp is a benchmark for evaluating AI agents' web browsing capabilities. It includes 1,266 challenging questions that require agents to continuously navigate the internet to find hard-to-discover information. Despite the difficulty, the answers are brief and easy to verify, making it a straightforward and user-friendly evaluation tool.
